name: Hebron
overview: Hebron, also known as Kirjath-Arba, is a city with deep biblical significance, noted as a place where Abraham mourned the death of Sarah and where both Abraham and Isaac sojourned. It was a fortified city, predating Zoan in Egypt by seven years, and was inhabited by the descendants of Anak at the time of the Israelite reconnaissance. Hebron also played a strategic role during the time of Joshua, as its king allied with other Canaanite rulers against Israel. Additionally, Hebron is linked to the Levitical family through the name Hebron among Kohath's sons, highlighting its connection to God's covenant people.
